office_does: The prosecuting attorney decides which crimes to charge and prosecutes them in Kittitas County's courts, and gives legal advice and representation to county government.
race_blurb: Open seat: Prosecutor Greg Zempel is retiring after eight terms and endorsed his chief criminal deputy, Jodi Hammond, who runs on experience and continuity. Aaron Reiman, a former military and city prosecutor now working as a public defender, runs as an independent on a fresh look at the office and more diversion. Hammond led the three-way primary 37% to 34%.

candidates.summary: Chief criminal deputy prosecutor with 22 years as a prosecutor, endorsed by retiring Prosecutor Greg Zempel and running on experience and continuity.
highlights: In the county prosecutor's office since 2011; chief criminal deputy since 2018 [S4]
Top priority: uphold Zempel's approach, fight for victims and hold offenders accountable [S5]
Endorsed by Zempel, Commissioner Brett Wachsmith and current and former police leaders [S3]
Says violent crime is rising and is resource-intensive for prosecutors [S6]

experience.basis: Office's chief criminal deputy for years, 22 years a prosecutor, running explicitly on experience as the retiring prosecutor's chosen successor.

safety.basis: Emphasizes holding offenders accountable and fighting for victims, endorsed by police leaders; no diversion or treatment proposals in the dossier.

reform.basis: Top priority is to uphold the values and approach set under Zempel rather than change the office.

candidates.summary: Ellensburg public defender and former Navy JAG, Coast Guard and city prosecutor, running as an independent to bring a fresh look and more diversion to the office.
highlights: Navy JAG and Coast Guard lawyer; Ellensburg city prosecutor from 2020; now a public defender [S1][S6]
Running as an independent to keep national politics out of the office [S4]
Would prosecute violent and repeat offenders while expanding pre-filing diversion and recovery-navigator referrals [S1][S4]
Would seek ways to lower diversion and treatment costs for indigent defendants [S4][S5]

experience.basis: Long legal career, but never worked in the county prosecutor's office and campaigns on a 'fresh slate, fresh eyes'.

safety.basis: Pairs prosecuting violent and repeat offenders with specific proposals for pre-filing diversion, cheaper treatment access and recovery-navigator referrals, more prevention-oriented than his opponent.

reform.basis: Would review what has and has not worked in the office and change how diversion and access to justice are handled.
